message.content: {"caption":"Five-panel grouped bar chart comparing F1 and BLEU-1 scores across k settings for Multi Hop, Temporal, Open Domain, Single Hop, and Adversarial tasks.","description":"Each panel plots k values 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50 on the horizontal axis and scores on a vertical axis. Blue bars represent F1 and orange bars represent BLEU-1; the legend appears in each panel. The panels have different vertical-axis ranges, and the axes do not all start at zero. Multi Hop: F1 rises from 19.91 at k=10 to about 25.5 at k=20, reaches 27.02 at k=40, then eases to 26.81 at k=50. BLEU-1 rises from 14.36 to about 20 by k=30 and stays near 20 thereafter. Temporal: F1 rises from 43.60 to 45.85 at k=40, then dips slightly to 45.60 at k=50; BLEU-1 climbs from 35.53 to 36.67 at k=40 before falling to 35.76. Open Domain: both series rise through k=30, dip at k=40, and rise again at k=50; F1 is 7.37, 10.29, 12.24, 10.35, and 12.12, while BLEU-1 is 7.03, 9.61, 10.57, 9.76, and 12.00. Single Hop: both series increase at every successive k; F1 goes from 31.15 to 44.55 and BLEU-1 from 25.43 to 37.02. Adversarial: both series rise through k=40, where they peak at 50.09 for F1 and 49.47 for BLEU-1, then fall at k=50 to 47.76 and 47.24, respectively. F1 is higher than BLEU-1 at each plotted k in all five panels.
